## HWM(test)

```{r}
rate_hwm <- function(
    shown,
    qvalue,
    reward,
    utility,
    params,
    system,
    ...
){
  
  list2env(list(...), envir = environment())
  
  # If you need extra information(...)
  # Column names may be lost(C++), indexes are recommended
  # e.g.
  # Trial  <- idinfo[3]
  # Frame  <- exinfo[1]
  # Action <- behave[1]
  
  alpha     <-  params[["alpha"]]
  alphaN    <-  params[["alphaN"]]
  alphaP    <-  params[["alphaP"]]
  
  # Determine the model currently in use based on which parameters are free.
  if (
    system == "RL" && !(is.null(alpha)) && is.null(alphaN) && is.null(alphaP)
  ) {
    model <- "TD"
  } else if (
    system == "RL" && is.null(alpha) && !(is.null(alphaN)) && !(is.null(alphaP))
  ) {
    model <- "RSTD"
  } else if (
    system == "WM"
  ) {
    model <- "WM"
    alpha <- 1
  } else {
    stop("Unknown Model! Plase modify your learning rate function")
  }

  # TD
  if (model == "TD") {
    update <- qvalue + alpha  * (utility - qvalue)
  # RSTD
  } else if (model == "RSTD" && utility < qvalue) {
    update <- qvalue + alphaN * (utility - qvalue)
  } else if (model == "RSTD" && utility >= qvalue) {
    update <- qvalue + alphaP * (utility - qvalue)
  # WM
  } else if (model == "WM") {
    update <- qvalue + alpha  * (reward - qvalue)
  }

  return(update)
}
```

```{r}
prob_hwm4 <- function(
    shown,
    qvalue, 
    explor,
    params,
    system,
    ...
){
  
  list2env(list(...), envir = environment())
  
  # If you need extra information(...)
  # Column names may be lost(C++), indexes are recommended
  # e.g.
  # Trial  <- idinfo[3]
  # Frame  <- exinfo[1]
  # Action <- behave[1]
  
  setsize  <- as.numeric(exinfo[1])
  
  beta     <- params[["beta"]]
  lapse    <- params[["lapse"]]
  #weight   <- params[["weight"]]
  capacity <- params[["capacity"]]

  index     <- which(!is.na(qvalue[[1]]))
  n_shown   <- length(index)
  n_system  <- length(qvalue)
  n_options <- length(qvalue[[1]])
  
  # Assign weights to different systems
  overload  <- min(1, capacity / setsize)
  rho <- c(1 - overload, overload)
  
  # Compute the probabilities estimated by different systems
  prob_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_options, ncol = n_system)
  
  if (explor == 1) {
    prob_mat[index, ] <- 1 / n_shown
    prob_mat[prob_mat == 0] <- NA
  } else {
    for (s in seq_len(n_system)) {
      sub_qvalue <- qvalue[[s]]
      exp_stable <- exp(beta * (sub_qvalue - max(sub_qvalue, na.rm = TRUE)))
      prob_mat[, s] <- exp_stable / sum(exp_stable, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  # Weighted average
  prob <- as.vector(prob_mat %*% rho)
  
  # lapse
  prob <- (1 - lapse * n_shown) * prob + lapse
  
  return(prob)
}
```

```{r}
dcay_wm <- function(
    shown,
    value0, 
    values,
    reward,
    params,
    system,
    ...
){
  
  list2env(list(...), envir = environment())
  
  # If you need extra information(...)
  # Column names may be lost(C++), indexes are recommended
  # e.g.
  # Trial  <- idinfo[3]
  # Frame  <- exinfo[1]
  # Action <- behave[1]
  
  zeta       <-  params[["zeta"]]
  bonus      <-  params[["bonus"]]
  
  if (system == "RL") {
    decay <- values
  } else if (system == "WM") {
    decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values)
    
    if (reward == 1) {
      decay <- ifelse(test = is.na(shown), yes = decay, no = 0)
    } 
  }
  
  return(decay)
}
```

```{r}
multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
  #engine = "R",
  data = data[data[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = 0.6,
      beta = 5,
      zeta = 0.1,
      capacity = 4
    ),
    fixed = list(gamma = 0, delta = 0),
    constant = list(weight = NA_real_, Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  ),
  priors = list(),
  settings = list(
    name = "HWM",
    mode = "fitting",
    estimate = "MLE",
    policy = "on",
    system = c("RL", "WM")
  ),
  funcs = list(rate_func = rate_hwm, prob_func = prob_hwm4, dcay_func = dcay_wm)
)

multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model)
```

## HWM(model)

```{r}
HWM <- function(params){
  
  params <- list(
    free = list(
      alpha = params[1], beta = params[2],
      zeta = params[3], capacity = params[4]
    ),
    fixed = list(gamma = 0, delta = 0),
    constant = list(weight = NA_real_, Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  )

  multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
    data = data,
    behrule = behrule,
    colnames = colnames,
    params = params,
    funcs = funcs,
    priors = priors,
    settings = settings
  )
  
  assign(x = "multiRL.model", value = multiRL.model, envir = multiRL.env)
  return(.return_result(multiRL.model))
}

```

## HWM(recovery)

```{r}
reticulate::use_condaenv(condaenv = "tf-gpu", required = TRUE)
```

```{r}
recovery <- multiRL::rcv_d(
  estimate = "MLE",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(HWM),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 0.2)},
      zeta = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)},
      capacity = function(x) {stats::runif(n = 1, min = 2, max = 6)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "HWM", system = c("RL", "WM"))),
  funcs = list(list(rate_func = rate_hwm, prob_func = prob_hwm4, dcay_func = dcay_wm)),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0, 0, 2)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 25, 1, 6)),
  control = list(
    core = 16, sample = 100, train = 1000,
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize"),
    reduction = "PCA"
  )
)

save(recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/recovery.HWM_4(-weight).Rdata")
```


## RLWM(fitting)

```{r}
fitting <- multiRL::fit_p(
  estimate = "MLE",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(HWM),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 0.1)},
      zeta = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)},
      capacity = function(x) {stats::runif(n = 1, min = 2, max = 6)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "HWM", system = c("RL", "WM"))),
  funcs = list(list(rate_func = rate_hwm, prob_func = prob_hwm4, dcay_func = dcay_wm)),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0, 0, 2)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 50, 1, 6)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, 
    # LBI
    iter = 100,
    # SBI
    train = 1000,
    # ABC
    reduction = "PCA", #ncomp = 6,
    # RNN
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize")
  )
)

save(fitting, file = "../OUTPUT/fitting.HWM_4(-weight).Rdata")
```
